entry_state: Execution preserves source revisions, joint constraints, conditional assumptions and atomic economic/accounting changes. Stable business-event identity resolves lost acknowledgements without duplicate postings. Worked debt and bond examples connect these procedures to coherent reports; the corporate operation package and information-access rules remain next.
exit_state: The bounded corporate package now links preconditions, economic state, postings and reports. Scenario modes and permitted information are explicit, and funding default remains distinct from unsupported computation. The next chapter can specify how external components exchange these typed results without taking over accounting authority.
findings: The operation table is a lookup for the already taught Northstar case. Performance, invoicing and settlement remain distinct even when dates coincide.
Reporting includes current profit once and classifies cash from economic events. An unexplained residual is never forced into a convenient operation.
Scenario visibility prevents future realized defaults from entering current measurement. Chapter 8 is complete with no new confirmed defect.
